commit.title: chore: replace Babel with esbuild
commit.message:
chore: replace Babel with esbuild

Babel was used in only two places: babel-jest transformed a handful of
ESM-only node_modules for unit tests, and @babel/cli transpiled three of
them to CommonJS for the integration tests. Neither touches production
code, which esbuild already builds.

esbuild now does both jobs, so @babel/cli, @babel/core and
@babel/preset-env are gone and the lockfile drops 99 packages. No new
dependency is added: esbuild and glob were already devDependencies.

This also removes a recurring maintenance cost: the @babel/preset-env v8
upgrade needed a @babel/core v8 bump, a ts-jest peer dependency
override, and a babel.config.js change because Babel 8 no longer
transforms ES modules to CommonJS by default.
